```{=html}
<style>
  .page-404 {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    min-height: 60vh;
    text-align: center;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    padding: 2rem 1rem;
  }

  /* Floating particles */
  .page-404::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    background-image:
      radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 10% 20%, rgba(34,211,238,0.3) 50%, transparent 50%),
      radial-gradient(1px 1px at 30% 65%, rgba(139,92,246,0.25) 50%, transparent 50%),
      radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 55% 15%, rgba(34,211,238,0.2) 50%, transparent 50%),
      radial-gradient(1px 1px at 75% 80%, rgba(139,92,246,0.3) 50%, transparent 50%),
      radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 85% 35%, rgba(34,211,238,0.25) 50%, transparent 50%),
      radial-gradient(1px 1px at 20% 85%, rgba(139,92,246,0.2) 50%, transparent 50%),
      radial-gradient(1.5px 1.5px at 65% 50%, rgba(34,211,238,0.15) 50%, transparent 50%),
      radial-gradient(1px 1px at 45% 90%, rgba(139,92,246,0.2) 50%, transparent 50%);
    animation: drift 20s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
  }

  @keyframes drift {
    0%   { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    100% { transform: translate(-15px, -20px); }
  }

  .page-404 > * {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  /* SVG Chart */
  .loss-chart {
    max-width: 500px;
    width: 100%;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  }

  /* Curve starts hidden, JS drives the draw */
  .loss-curve {
    transition: none;
  }

  /* 404 glow pulse after animation ends */
  .text-404-glow-pulse {
    animation: pulse-glow 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  @keyframes pulse-glow {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; }
    50%      { opacity: 0.6; }
  }

  /* Axis tick animation */
  .axis-element {
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fade-in 0.6s ease-out forwards;
  }

  @keyframes fade-in {
    to { opacity: 1; }
  }

  /* Message */
  .error-headline {
    font-size: 1.8rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: #eaf2ff;
    letter-spacing: 0.4px;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.35), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fade-in 0.8s ease-out 4.2s forwards;
  }

  .error-subtext {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    color: rgba(234,242,255,0.6);
    margin: 0 0 2rem 0;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fade-in 0.8s ease-out 4.5s forwards;
  }

  .error-subtext code {
    color: #22d3ee;
    background: rgba(34,211,238,0.1);
    padding: 0.15em 0.4em;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font-size: 0.95em;
  }

  /* Home button */
  .home-btn {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 0.7rem 1.8rem;
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #22d3ee, #8b5cf6);
    color: #fff !important;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: fade-in 0.8s ease-out 4.8s forwards;
  }

  .home-btn:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(34,211,238,0.3), 0 3px 10px rgba(139,92,246,0.2);
  }

  /* Hide default quarto title block */
  #title-block-header { display: none; }
</style>

<div class="page-404">
  <svg class="loss-chart" viewBox="0 -10 500 370" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" overflow="visible">
    <defs>
      <linearGradient id="curveGrad" x1="0" y1="1" x2="1" y2="0">
        <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#22d3ee"/>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8b5cf6"/>
      </linearGradient>
      <!-- Animated flowing gradient using the site's color palette -->
      <linearGradient id="curveGradAnim" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="0" y1="0" x2="500" y2="0">
        <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#22d3ee"><animate attributeName="stop-color" values="#22d3ee;#8b5cf6;#a78bfa;#22d3ee" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></stop>
        <stop offset="25%"  stop-color="#8b5cf6"><animate attributeName="stop-color" values="#8b5cf6;#a78bfa;#22d3ee;#8b5cf6" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></stop>
        <stop offset="50%"  stop-color="#a78bfa"><animate attributeName="stop-color" values="#a78bfa;#22d3ee;#8b5cf6;#a78bfa" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></stop>
        <stop offset="75%"  stop-color="#22d3ee"><animate attributeName="stop-color" values="#22d3ee;#8b5cf6;#a78bfa;#22d3ee" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></stop>
        <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8b5cf6"><animate attributeName="stop-color" values="#8b5cf6;#a78bfa;#22d3ee;#8b5cf6" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></stop>
      </linearGradient>
      <filter id="glow404" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
        <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="6" result="blur"/>
        <feMerge>
          <feMergeNode in="blur"/>
          <feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/>
        </feMerge>
      </filter>
      <filter id="softGlow" x="-50%" y="-50%" width="200%" height="200%">
        <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="12"/>
      </filter>
    </defs>

    <!-- Y axis -->
    <line class="axis-element" style="animation-delay:0.2s"
      x1="70" y1="30" x2="70" y2="290"
      stroke="rgba(234,242,255,0.25)" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- X axis -->
    <line class="axis-element" style="animation-delay:0.3s"
      x1="70" y1="290" x2="460" y2="290"
      stroke="rgba(234,242,255,0.25)" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <!-- Y axis label -->
    <text class="axis-element" style="animation-delay:0.4s"
      x="30" y="165" fill="rgba(234,242,255,0.45)"
      font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" text-anchor="middle"
      transform="rotate(-90,30,165)">Loss</text>

    <!-- X axis label -->
    <text class="axis-element" style="animation-delay:0.5s"
      x="265" y="325" fill="rgba(234,242,255,0.45)"
      font-size="13" font-family="sans-serif" text-anchor="middle">Epochs</text>

    <!-- Y tick marks -->
    <line class="axis-element" style="animation-delay:0.3s" x1="65" y1="225" x2="70" y2="225" stroke="rgba(234,242,255,0.2)" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line class="axis-element" style="animation-delay:0.3s" x1="65" y1="160" x2="70" y2="160" stroke="rgba(234,242,255,0.2)" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line class="axis-element" style="animation-delay:0.3s" x1="65" y1="95" x2="70" y2="95" stroke="rgba(234,242,255,0.2)" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- X tick marks -->
    <line class="axis-element" style="animation-delay:0.4s" x1="170" y1="290" x2="170" y2="295" stroke="rgba(234,242,255,0.2)" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line class="axis-element" style="animation-delay:0.4s" x1="265" y1="290" x2="265" y2="295" stroke="rgba(234,242,255,0.2)" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line class="axis-element" style="animation-delay:0.4s" x1="360" y1="290" x2="360" y2="295" stroke="rgba(234,242,255,0.2)" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- Grid lines (subtle) -->
    <line class="axis-element" style="animation-delay:0.3s" x1="70" y1="225" x2="460" y2="225" stroke="rgba(234,242,255,0.05)" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line class="axis-element" style="animation-delay:0.3s" x1="70" y1="160" x2="460" y2="160" stroke="rgba(234,242,255,0.05)" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line class="axis-element" style="animation-delay:0.3s" x1="70" y1="95" x2="460" y2="95"  stroke="rgba(234,242,255,0.05)" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- Noisy diverging loss curve (smooth spline) -->
    <defs>
      <path id="losspath"
        d="M 80,260
           C 90,264 98,252 108,256
           S 122,262 132,254
           S 148,248 158,252
           S 172,242 182,246
           S 196,238 206,243
           S 220,234 230,239
           S 244,232 254,236
           S 268,230 278,234
           S 290,232 298,236
           S 306,234 312,240
           S 320,236 328,244
           S 336,238 342,250
           S 350,242 356,236
           S 362,226 368,218
           S 375,210 380,198
           S 388,188 393,175
           S 400,162 406,148
           S 414,132 420,118
           S 428,100 434,84
           S 442,66 450,48"/>
    </defs>

    <!-- Glow version (behind) -->
    <use id="curveGlow" href="#losspath" fill="none" stroke="url(#curveGrad)" stroke-width="8"
      stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"
      opacity="0.15" filter="url(#softGlow)"/>

    <!-- Main curve -->
    <use id="curveMain" href="#losspath" fill="none" stroke="url(#curveGrad)" stroke-width="2.5"
      stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

    <!-- Animated rainbow curve (hidden until draw completes) -->
    <use id="curveRainbow" href="#losspath" fill="none" stroke="url(#curveGradAnim)" stroke-width="2.5"
      stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0" style="transition: opacity 0.8s ease-in"/>
    <use id="curveRainbowGlow" href="#losspath" fill="none" stroke="url(#curveGradAnim)" stroke-width="8"
      stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0" filter="url(#softGlow)" style="transition: opacity 0.8s ease-in"/>

    <!-- 404 text that follows the curve tip -->
    <text id="label404glow" filter="url(#softGlow)"
      font-size="32" font-weight="800" font-family="sans-serif"
      text-anchor="middle" fill="#8b5cf6" opacity="0.4">404</text>
    <text id="label404" filter="url(#glow404)"
      font-size="32" font-weight="800" font-family="sans-serif"
      text-anchor="middle" fill="#eaf2ff">404</text>
  </svg>

  <script>
  (function() {
    const path = document.getElementById('losspath');
    const curveMain = document.getElementById('curveMain');
    const curveGlow = document.getElementById('curveGlow');
    const label = document.getElementById('label404');
    const labelGlow = document.getElementById('label404glow');
    const totalLen = path.getTotalLength();
    const duration = 4000;

    // Hide curves initially
    [curveMain, curveGlow].forEach(function(el) {
      el.style.strokeDasharray = totalLen;
      el.style.strokeDashoffset = totalLen;
    });

    // Position label at start
    var startPt = path.getPointAtLength(0);
    [label, labelGlow].forEach(function(el) {
      el.setAttribute('x', startPt.x);
      el.setAttribute('y', startPt.y - 22);
    });

    var startTime = null;
    function easeOut(t) { return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3); }

    function animate(ts) {
      if (!startTime) startTime = ts;
      var raw = Math.min((ts - startTime) / duration, 1);
      var t = easeOut(raw);
      var drawn = t * totalLen;

      // Draw curve
      var offset = totalLen - drawn;
      curveMain.style.strokeDashoffset = offset;
      curveGlow.style.strokeDashoffset = offset;

      // Move 404 label to curve tip
      var pt = path.getPointAtLength(drawn);
      label.setAttribute('x', pt.x);
      label.setAttribute('y', pt.y - 22);
      labelGlow.setAttribute('x', pt.x);
      labelGlow.setAttribute('y', pt.y - 22);

      if (raw < 1) {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      } else {
        labelGlow.classList.add('text-404-glow-pulse');
        // Fade in the animated rainbow gradient over the static curve
        document.getElementById('curveRainbow').setAttribute('opacity', '1');
        document.getElementById('curveRainbowGlow').setAttribute('opacity', '0.15');
      }
    }

    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  })();
  </script>

  <h1 class="error-headline">Training diverged.</h1>
  <p class="error-subtext">The page you're looking for overfit to <code>/dev/null</code>.</p>
  <a href="/" class="home-btn">Back to Home</a>
</div>
```
